semantic_fragments.content: ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE is performance, the absence or degradation of which, would result in an unacceptable risk.
Section 4.3 Essential Performance: The identified essential performance function is 'Limits of the error of the thermometer', referenced in Risk Assessment Report DN: PT9L-FXPJ01 V1.0.

Section 4.6 RM Results Table - ME Equipment or system parts contacting the patient: The probe is defined as an applied part. Hazards are addressed. Risk of each hazardous situation is estimated. Risks of each hazardous situation are evaluated. Risk reduction measures are defined. Risk control measures are defined. Risk controls measure implementation is defined. Residual risk level is defined (Silia gel pad). Referenced documents: PT9L-FXPJ01 V1.0 and PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0.

Section 4.7 RM Results Table - Single Fault Condition for ME Equipment: Intended use and identification of characteristics related to safety issues analysed and recorded. Hazard analysis recorded. Risk estimation recorded. All results pass (P). Referenced document: PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0.

Section 4.8 RM Results Table - Components of ME Equipment: Intended use and characteristics related to safety analysed and recorded. Hazard analysis recorded. Risk estimation recorded. Risk evaluation recorded. Risk control option analysis recorded. Risk control measures recorded with effectiveness verified. Residual risk evaluated. All residual risk acceptable (N/A verdict for 7.5). Referenced document: PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0.

Section 4.5 RM RESULTS TABLE: Equivalent Safety for ME Equipment of ME System - Result: N/A. Section 4.9 RM RESULTS TABLE: Use of components with high-integrity characteristics - Result: N/A. These sections are not applicable for this device.
